h3.regret_definition: held-out fake-RTN NLL minus matched FP NLL; two seeds averaged within domain

g3.reason: Solver correctness passed and Domain-Mean has limited directional evidence, but no robust objective improves worst-domain NLL over Concat.

frozen_next_scope.quantization: frozen GPTQ/RFT with real packed checkpoints
forbidden: tuning domain weights, CVaR alpha, or normalization on Phase 3 held-out results
claiming worst-domain quality improvement from fake RTN
expanding to a second model before the OLMoE real-checkpoint gate

known_limits: Phase 3 quality uses fake RTN and is selection evidence only.
BoolQ is measured as templated language-model NLL, not official task accuracy.
AlphaQ-style uses a deterministic spectral sketch and is not an exact FARMS reproduction.
Concat pools frozen per-token coefficients rather than rerunning an additional joint calibration backward pass.
